headline: Kyrgyzstan GDP Expands 10.5% Year-on-Year to $21.3 Billion in Jan-Oct 2026
summary: Kyrgyzstan's gross domestic product rose 10.5% in the first ten months of 2026 to reach $21.34 billion, official government statistics revealed. Economic growth was driven by trade expansion and increased construction output.
why: Kyrgyzstan's economic growth figures reflect trade transit corridors and domestic output across Central Asia.

impacts.name: Kyrgyzstan
impacts.why: Economic growth accelerated 10.5% over the ten-month period due to trade and industrial gains.
